grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.

title: A Class Looks Back: Our First Month
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方雅思测试）。请先阅读短文，注意过去时was/were、常用过去式、be going to和because的用法。然后完成8道阅读题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。建议先看题再读文章。
passage: Last month, our beginner English class had a problem. The classroom was small. There were only eight chairs, but there were twelve students. We were not happy. Our teacher, Ms. Li, was very kind. She said, "I am sorry. The big room was closed last week because of a water problem." We were sad, but we listened. Ms. Li said, "Next week, we are going to use the library room. It is big and quiet." We were happy because the library room is nice. Now we are in the library room. There are many chairs and a big window. We are going to have a small party on Friday because our class is fun. We were worried before, but now we are fine.

questions.prompt: How many chairs were in the small classroom?
questions.explanation: 文章说“There were only eight chairs”，所以是八把椅子。
questions.evidence: There were only eight chairs, but there were twelve students.

questions.prompt: How many students were in the class?
questions.explanation: 文章说“there were twelve students”，所以是十二名学生。
questions.evidence: There were only eight chairs, but there were twelve students.

questions.prompt: Why was the big room closed last week?
questions.explanation: 文章说“The big room was closed last week because of a water problem.”，原因是水的问题。
questions.evidence: The big room was closed last week because of a water problem.

questions.prompt: Where is the class going to go next week?
questions.explanation: 老师说“Next week, we are going to use the library room.”，所以下周去图书馆房间。
questions.evidence: Next week, we are going to use the library room.

questions.prompt: Why are the students happy now?
options: Because the library room is nice
Because the small room is big
answers: Because the library room is nice
questions.explanation: 文章说“We were happy because the library room is nice.”，所以现在开心是因为图书馆房间很好。
questions.evidence: We were happy because the library room is nice.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: The library room is big and ______.
questions.explanation: 文章说“It is big and quiet.”，所以填quiet。

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: We are going to have a small party on ______.
questions.explanation: 文章说“We are going to have a small party on Friday”，所以填Friday。
questions.evidence: We are going to have a small party on Friday because our class is fun.

questions.explanation: 文章说“Our teacher, Ms. Li, was very kind.”，所以老师是李老师。
questions.evidence: Our teacher, Ms. Li, was very kind.

grammar.title: 过去时 was/were 与 be going to 入门
grammar.explanation: 英语中表示过去的状态，用was/were。I/he/she/it用was，you/we/they用were。否定在was/were后加not，如was not (wasn't), were not (weren't)。表示计划或打算做某事，用be going to + 动词原形，如I am going to study. 表示原因用because，后面接句子。
grammar.example: The classroom was small. We were not happy. We are going to use the library room because it is nice.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: Yesterday, I ______ at home.
Choose the correct word: They ______ happy last week.
questions.evidence: We were happy because the library room is nice.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She ______ not at school yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语是She，过去否定用was not。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We ______ going to visit the museum next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 主语是We，be going to结构用are going to。
questions.evidence: We are going to have a small party on Friday because our class is fun.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: He is going to ______ a new book tomorrow.
questions.explanation: be going to后接动词原形，所以用buy。
questions.evidence: We are going to use the library room.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I was late ______ the bus was late.
questions.evidence: We were happy because the library room is nice.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ you at the party last night?
questions.explanation: 主语是you，过去时疑问句用Were。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The students ______ going to have a test next week.
questions.explanation: 主语是The students（复数），be going to用are。
questions.evidence: We are going to have a small party on Friday because our class is fun.

transfer.writing: Write 5 sentences about a problem in your class last week. Use was/were, because, and be going to. Example: The room was small. We were not happy because there were no chairs. We are going to use a new room.
